**Daily Devotional**

**July 6**

*16 And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace. 17 For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ. (John 1:16-17 KJV)*

This of course is speaking of Christians, as unbelievers have not received anything from Jesus. It is awesome that we have received the fullness of Jesus in our spirits (Galatians 4:6), as we now have all in us that is in Jesus Himself (Colossians 2:10). It makes it even more awesome when you realize that Jesus had the fullness of the Godhead in Him (Colossians 2:9), meaning that all born again believers now have the fullness of the Godhead in themselves – Wow!

The law was given by God through Moses, and was in effect until Jesus came to earth and brought the salvation of man by the Grace and Truth of the New Covenant (Hebrews 8:10-13). Many Christians are still trying to live under the Old Testament Law instead of the New Covenant brought to us by Jesus. You need to read the Word and know that there is much that is different between the Old and New Testaments, and it is not just a blank page in your bible. You cannot please God by living under the Law as He is pleased by our faith (Hebrews 11;6), but you need to accept the Grace and Mercy that Jesus brought to us, as no one can become righteous by the law (Romans 3:20). Thank you Jesus for giving us so much.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
